title: E0 paper-profile checkpoint form B
instructions: Apply the reported English paper profile to three fresh decisions without help.

parts.prompt: Which practice activity most accurately reproduces the reported open-cloze demand?

options.text: Select every answer from a shared box of extra words
Write one suitable word for each gap, then check grammar, collocation and whole-passage meaning
Correct punctuation errors in isolated sentences
Memorise a list without reading a passage

choice_rationales.A: That describes banked cloze, not open cloze.
choice_rationales.B: Open cloze requires exact-word generation supported by local and global context.
choice_rationales.C: A separate editing section is not part of the reported format.
choice_rationales.D: The task requires contextual language decisions.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Open cloze supplies no answer bank, so learners must generate and verify each word.

parts.prompt: Which revision set best matches the reported reading-comprehension component?

options.text: Two passages with contextual synonym, reference and evidence-based multiple-choice questions
Only spelling lists and handwriting drills
A spoken debate with no text

choice_rationales.A: This aligns both the passage material and the reported reasoning operations.
choice_rationales.B: Those activities do not measure passage comprehension.
choice_rationales.D: Editing is not the reported reading task.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Aligned practice uses passages and requires learners to justify meaning and reference from evidence.

parts.prompt: A practice platform finishes Section 1 with eight minutes unused. What is the safest rule for those minutes?

options.text: Delete them from the total test time
Keep the two section clocks separate unless official instructions explicitly permit transfer

choice_rationales.A: Time transfer has not been officially confirmed.
choice_rationales.B: Unused time does not change the reported limit.
choice_rationales.C: The section limits remain useful preparation evidence.
choice_rationales.D: This avoids inventing flexibility not supported by the current evidence.

parts.hint: Protected checkpoint: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: Separate practice clocks are the fail-safe assumption until official instructions state otherwise.
